There were no current records for the dates of administration of distemper and parvovirus vaccines or of the
administration of parasite control medication. The Program of Veterinary Care (PVC) does have directions for these and
was present for inspection. Licensee stated that these have been administered but that no record exists. It is important to
keep updated and accurate records of parasite control medication and vaccinations provided and the dates they were
given to each regulated animal. The lack of complete records, including dates given could cause a regulated animal to be
over or under dosed, or missed completely in the parasite control and/or vaccination protocols. The licensee must keep
and maintain medical records that include the names of all vaccines and treatments administered, and the dates of
administration.
To be corrected going forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
